name: Punchly
tagline: Tap an NFC tag at the counter to collect a virtual punch-card stamp; merchants see the analytics.
problem: Paper punch cards get lost and QR codes are slow, the team says.
solution: An NFC tap deep-links into the app to log a visit and add a stamp toward a reward; a Flask dashboard lets merchants manage stamps and see analytics.
demo_moment: Team-described: tap the tag and watch the stamp count rise.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “ColorStack Most Portable Project” among 217 submissions.
A one-second interaction designed for phones.

lessons: Make the core interaction faster than the thing it replaces.
